mechanism_narrative: A sustained year-over-year increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS shows year-over-year growth.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous year-over-year expansion in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both PAYEMS and RSAFS show year-over-year growth.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 310 signals persistent high inflation that triggers Fed policy tightening expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 310.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 102.0 signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 102.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous year-over-year growth in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 show year-over-year growth.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that supports wage growth and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index above 315.0 signals accelerating inflation that triggers aggressive monetary policy expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 315.0.
